data.name: Revolution 1.5-9
data.author: Thumblegudget, Bredroll, QuantX, NexusQuille + Others
data.description:
The Revolution mod brings Radar enhancements, a more immersive fog-of-war for island captures and other features.
Recent changes: [list] [*] Next generation aircraft RWR sensor [*] Reduce lag when there are many hundreds of units (when unmodded does not lag) [*] Fix Stutter when walking around the bridge after joining or loading a game. [*] Reduce unnecessary extra computation for radars by using a proxy object [*] Walrus can carry the 'small' low damage turret as well as a main attachment. [/list]
v1.5: [list] [*] EW - Electronic Warfare target fuzzing [*] HUD assistance for guided/cruise missile operation [*] HUD horizon ladder can now be togged off/on by double tapping the map [*] HUD 20mm gun-sight less cluttered when horizon ladder hidden [*] Helm gets a basic HUD showing nearby islands and compass course [*] Turrets can now be moved around by ground vehicles pushing. [/list]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3496283808]v1.4 available here[/url] [list] [*] Bear cannon now has a range guide for the current target [*] Carrier and Surface RADAR can now indicate the direction of the nearest hostile RADAR source on the holomap. [*] Carrier and other units carrying RADAR show a map symbol on holomap, control and nav screens. If carrier radar is offline the symbol is red or damaged the symbol flashes red/grey. [*] Added support for the Resupply+ extension mod. [/list]
[list] [*] Fog of war [*] Needlefish rebalance (reduced simulated Radar range) [*] AWACS rebalance (~10-12km max range again for a better feel) [*] Manta rebalance (less deadly against carriers for more air combat) [*] Bomb enemy factories to slow production [*] Barge map/info will now warn when your barge has no delivery waypoints [*] Operator screen will show island type in command center tooltips [*] Loadout screen can now manage loadouts for units on a different carrier [/list]
For full details on what the mod does, how you can contribute or request features see [url=https://cc2maps.com/revolution-mod/]https://cc2maps.com/revolution-mod/[/url]
The mod is based on UI Enhancer and Albatross AWACS, so you get those amazing benefits included.
